blurb: The Village Club at Pheasant Ridge is a private member club limited to 225 family memberships and additional senior memberships. Members enjoy tennis, racquet sports, swimming, equestrian boarding, summer camps, and social events. The club features historic Kistler Stables as the main clubhouse and offers a family-friendly environment.
